summary: An untouched web window no longer writes its empty startup workspace, so it does not replace tabs freshly opened in another window

replay.detail: Client-only workspace persistence change; no replay or rebuild.

schema.detail: The stored workspace encoding and schema are unchanged; only an untouched empty startup write is skipped.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client capability or public API changes; existing workspace documents retain their format.

downtime.detail: No restart-time work or additional interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action or migration is required.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous startup persistence behavior without a data migration; it does not restore tabs already replaced by that behavior.
